target.title: fix(tlon): add timeouts to file upload HTTP requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
`uploadFile` in `extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.ts` makes three outbound HTTP requests via `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a `timeoutMs`: the Memex upload URL lookup, the Memex upload PUT, and the custom S3 signed-URL PUT. Without explicit timeouts, stalled servers can hang the request indefinitely, matching the class of issues fixed in #102027, #102025, #102050.

## Why This Change Was Made
Add named constants and forward `timeoutMs` to all three `fetchWithSsrFGuard` calls so upload operations fail fast and release resources.

## User Impact
File uploads to Tlon time out predictably instead of hanging.

## Evidence
- `pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.test.ts --run` passes (15 tests).
- New assertions verify `timeoutMs: 30_000` for the Memex upload URL lookup and `timeoutMs: 120_000` for the actual upload calls.

## Real behavior proof
**Label:** timeout
**Surface:** `extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.ts`
**Behavior:** `getMemexUploadUrl` and both upload `fetchWithSsrFGuard` calls now include `timeoutMs`.
**Proof:** Local unit test run confirms the values are passed:
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  15 passed (15)
```
